aggregation_policy: finalizer aggregates existing 30 run artifacts only; it never trains or regenerates caches
architecture_contract: frozen WHAT128 spikes + frozen context64 -> fixed W_what/W_when -> short-memory non-recurrent Fusion128 -> fixed W_out -> per-timestep 12D evidence -> non-leaky whole-sequence accumulator
causality_contract: elapsed baseline uses absolute t/fs only; final duration is not an input to any condition; valid length only masks padded updates and selects the endpoint
output_bias_contract: W_out has no bias; one class bias is added once after accumulation
primary_comparisons: what_when_fusion_lif vs what_only_lif: does WHEN add task value beyond WHAT?
what_when_fusion_lif vs what_elapsed_lif: does learned WHEN beat a strong causal clock?
what_when_fusion_lif vs what_resetwhen_lif: does ordered temporal history matter?
what_when_fusion_lif vs what_when_linear: does Fusion LIF threshold/state interaction matter?
when_only_lif: how much letter identity remains in WHEN alone?
run_order: condition-major, five seeds per condition: what_only_lif, when_only_lif, what_elapsed_lif, what_resetwhen_lif, what_when_linear, what_when_fusion_lif
scientific_question: whether frozen history-dependent WHEN spikes improve final letter classification by contextualizing frozen WHAT spikes in a fixed-synapse Fusion LIF layer
winner_logic: the WHEN fusion hypothesis is strongest when the main condition beats WHAT-only, elapsed-time, reset-WHEN and parameter-matched linear fusion, and aligned WHEN degrades when zeroed/shuffled/shifted
